I have a complete map. Here are my findings.

## Build tool & running tests
- Build tool: Maven (`/home/daniel/sandbox/pom.xml`, wrapper `./mvnw`; no Gradle files).
- Run full suite: `./mvnw test` (or `./mvnw verify`) from `/home/daniel/sandbox`. Readme references `mvn clean install` (`readme.md:218`). The acceptance test lives under `src/test/.../acceptance/` and runs as a normal JUnit 5 test.

## 1. customerCode generation
`/home/daniel/sandbox/src/main/java/org/springframework/samples/petclinic/rest/validation/CustomerCodeGenerator.java`
- Format today is `<CITY3>-<LAST3>-<NNNN>` (NOT region/hash/telephone-based).

```java
38  public static String generate(String city, String lastName, long cityOwnerCount) {
39      String city3 = prefix(city);
40      String last3 = prefix(lastName);
41      return String.format("%s-%s-%04d", city3, last3, cityOwnerCount + 1);
42  }
44  private static String prefix(String value) {
45      return value.substring(0, Math.min(3, value.length())).toUpperCase();
46  }
```
- CITY3 = first 3 letters of city, LAST3 = first 3 letters of lastName, NNNN = 4-digit per-city sequence = `cityOwnerCount + 1`.
- Called from the controller `OwnerRestControllerV1.addOwner` at `/home/daniel/sandbox/src/main/java/org/springframework/samples/petclinic/rest/controller/v1/OwnerRestControllerV1.java:162-163`:
```java
162  owner.setCustomerCode(CustomerCodeGenerator.generate(owner.getCity(), owner.getLastName(),
163      this.cityOwnerCounter.count(owner.getCity())));
```
- No region code, postcode, telephone, or hash is used in the current customerCode. (The acceptance test expects a redesign — see item 7.)

## 2. Region code derivation from postcode
`/home/daniel/sandbox/src/main/java/org/springframework/samples/petclinic/model/RegionPostcodes.java`
- `regionForPostcode(String)` maps a 4-digit postcode to a region via inclusive ranges (`RegionPostcodes.java:40-57`): NSW 2000-2099, VIC 3000-3099, QLD 4000-4099 (`:25-28`). Returns `null` when absent/non-numeric/out of range.
- `isValidForRegion(String region, int postcode)` at `:68-71` (permissive when region unknown).
- City→region table fallback: `/home/daniel/sandbox/src/main/java/org/springframework/samples/petclinic/model/CityRegions.java` — `regionOf(String city)` (`:40-42`), table Sydney→NSW/Melbourne→VIC/Brisbane→QLD (`:28-31`), else `UNKNOWN` (`:26`).

## 3. Membership number & check digit
- Membership number: `/home/daniel/sandbox/src/main/java/org/springframework/samples/petclinic/rest/validation/MembershipNumberGenerator.java:38-40` — format `<customerCode>-M<YY>` (YY = registration year mod 100, zero-padded):
```java
38  public static String generate(String customerCode, LocalDate registrationDate) {
39      return String.format("%s-M%02d", customerCode, registrationDate.getYear() % 100);
40  }
```
Set in controller `OwnerRestControllerV1.java:165` (after save, so `customerCode` is already assigned).
- Check digit: computed from `customerCode`, not membership number. `/home/daniel/sandbox/src/main/java/org/springframework/samples/petclinic/model/Owner.java:229-232`:
```java
230  public int getCheckDigit() {
231      return LuhnCheckDigit.of(this.customerCode);
232  }
```
- Luhn algorithm: `/home/daniel/sandbox/src/main/java/org/springframework/samples/petclinic/rest/validation/LuhnCheckDigit.java:35-54` — iterates digits right-to-left, doubling alternate digits (starting doubled), skips non-digits, returns `(10 - sum%10) % 10`.

## 4. Create audit record logic
`/home/daniel/sandbox/src/main/java/org/springframework/samples/petclinic/rest/audit/OwnerAuditLogger.java:40-43` — logs to dedicated `"AUDIT"` SLF4J logger:
```java
41  AUDIT.info("Owner created: id={} customerCode={} registrationDate={} membershipLevel={}",
42      owner.getId(), owner.getCustomerCode(), owner.getRegistrationDate(), owner.getMembershipLevel());
```
Invoked at `OwnerRestControllerV1.java:166` (`this.ownerAuditLogger.logCreated(owner)`), after save and after membership number assignment.

## 5. Locality derivation
`/home/daniel/sandbox/src/main/java/org/springframework/samples/petclinic/model/Owner.java:199-203`:
```java
200  public String getLocality() {
201      String region = RegionPostcodes.regionForPostcode(this.postcode);
202      return region != null ? region : CityRegions.regionOf(this.city);
203  }
```
Postcode range lookup first, then city-to-region table, else `UNKNOWN`. Note: the OpenAPI doc (`openapi.yml:2190-2196`) still describes locality as city-table-only — a doc/implementation drift worth noting.

## 6. Sequence number generation/storage
- There is NO dedicated sequence entity/repository/DB sequence. The customerCode "sequence" is derived at runtime by counting existing owners in the city: `/home/daniel/sandbox/src/main/java/org/springframework/samples/petclinic/rest/validation/CityOwnerCounter.java:43-47`:
```java
43  public long count(String city) {
44      return this.clinicService.findAllOwners().stream()
45          .filter(existing -> existing.getCity() != null && existing.getCity().equalsIgnoreCase(city))
46          .count();
47  }
```
This is in-memory, case-insensitive, and not concurrency-safe (no DB sequence / locking).
- The only JPA id generation is the entity primary key: `/home/daniel/sandbox/src/main/java/org/springframework/samples/petclinic/model/BaseEntity.java:33-34` (`@GeneratedValue(strategy = GenerationType.IDENTITY)`).
- Related counters (same pattern): `NamesakeCounter.java` (first+last name count → membershipLevel/namesakeCount), `DailyRegistrationCounter.java`.

components:
  schemas:
    ProblemDetail:
      title: Problem Detail
      description: The schema for all error responses.
      type: object
      properties:
        type:
          title: Type
          description: Full URL that originated the error response.
          type: string
          format: uri
          example: 'http://localhost:9966/petclinic/api/owner'
          readOnly: true
        title:
          title: Title
          description: The short error title.
          type: string
          example: NoResourceFoundException
          readOnly: true
        status:
          title: Status
          description: HTTP status code
          type: integer
          format: int32
          minimum: 400
          maximum: 600
          exclusiveMaximum: true
          example: 500
          readOnly: true
        detail:
          title: Detail
          description: The long error message.
          type: string
          example: 'No static resource api/owner.'
          readOnly: true
        timestamp:
          title: Timestamp
          description: The time the error occurred.
          type: string
          format: date-time
          example: '2024-11-23T13:59:21.3820407Z'
          readOnly: true
        schemaValidationErrors:
          title: Schema validation errors
          description: Validation errors against the OpenAPI schema.
          type: array
          items:
            $ref: '#/components/schemas/ValidationMessage'
      required:
        - type
        - title
        - status
        - detail
        - timestamp
        - schemaValidationErrors
    ValidationMessage:
      title: Validation message
      description: Messages describing a validation error.
      type: object
      properties:
        message:
          title: Message
          description: The validation message.
          type: string
          example: "[Path '/lastName'] Instance type (null) does not match any allowed primitive type (allowed: ['string'])"
          readOnly: true
      required:
        - message
      additionalProperties: true
    Specialty:
      title: Specialty
      description: Fields of specialty of vets.
      type: object
      properties:
        id:
          title: ID
          description: The ID of the specialty.
          type: integer
          format: int32
          minimum: 0
          example: 1
          readOnly: true
        name:
          title: Name
          description: The name of the specialty.
          type: string
          maxLength: 80
          minLength: 1
          example: radiology
      required:
        - id
        - name
    OwnerFields:
      title: Owner fields
      description: Editable fields of a pet owner.
      type: object
      properties:
        firstName:
          title: First name
          description: The first name of the pet owner.
          type: string
          minLength: 1
          maxLength: 30
          pattern: "^[\\p{L}]+([ '-][\\p{L}]+){0,2}$"
          example: George
        lastName:
          title: Last name
          description: The last name of the pet owner.
          type: string
          minLength: 1
          maxLength: 30
          pattern: "^[\\p{L}]+([ '-][\\p{L}]+){0,2}\\.?$"
          example: Franklin
        address:
          title: Address
          description: The postal address of the pet owner.
          type: string
          minLength: 1
          maxLength: 255
          example: '110 W. Liberty St.'
        city:
          title: City
          description: The city of the pet owner.
          type: string
          minLength: 1
          maxLength: 80
          example: Madison
        telephone:
          title: Telephone number
          description: >-
            The telephone number of the pet owner. On create the value is
            normalized to E.164 form: a leading '+' and country code are kept,
            otherwise country code '+61' is assumed and a single leading '0' is
            dropped from the national digits; spaces, dashes and brackets are
            stripped. The result must be '+' followed by 8 to 15 digits, and this
            E.164 value is stored and returned.
          type: string
          minLength: 1
          maxLength: 20
          example: '+61412345678'
        email:
          title: Email address
          description: >-
            The optional email address of the pet owner. When present it must be
            a syntactically valid address; the value is stored and returned
            lower-cased.
          type: string
          maxLength: 255
          example: george.franklin@example.com
        postcode:
          title: Postcode
          description: >-
            The optional 4-digit postcode of the pet owner. When present it must
            be valid for the owner's city: the city's region (Sydney->NSW,
            Melbourne->VIC, Brisbane->QLD) fixes an inclusive range (NSW
            2000-2099, VIC 3000-3099, QLD 4000-4099) that the postcode must fall
            within; a city with no known region accepts any 4-digit postcode. The
            value is stored and returned as given.
          type: string
          pattern: '^[0-9]{4}$'
          example: '2000'
        registrationDate:
          title: Registration date
          description: >-
            The date the pet owner was registered, formatted as 'YYYY-MM-DD'.
            When omitted on create it defaults to the server's current date.
          type: string
          format: date
          example: '2020-06-15'
        sharesHousehold:
          title: Shares household
          description: >-
            Optional create-time flag. When set to true and an existing owner
            already lives at the same last name and address, the new owner joins
            that household and shares its household id (compared
            case-insensitively, ignoring surrounding and repeated whitespace).
            Because the household id is part of the identity key, joining a
            household still leaves the new owner with a distinct identity as long
            as its telephone or email differs. This flag is not persisted.
          type: boolean
          example: false
      required:
        - firstName
        - lastName
        - address
        - city
        - telephone
    Owner:
      title: Owner
      description: A pet owner.
      allOf:
        - $ref: '#/components/schemas/OwnerFields'
        - type: object
          properties:
            id:
              title: ID
              description: The ID of the pet owner.
              type: integer
              format: int32
              minimum: 0
              example: 1
              readOnly: true
            displayName:
              title: Display name
              description: The pet owner's name formatted as 'LastName, FirstName'.
              type: string
              example: 'Franklin, George'
              readOnly: true
            initials:
              title: Initials
              description: >-
                The upper-cased first letters of the owner's first and last
                name, dot-separated with a trailing dot.
              type: string
              example: 'G.F.'
              readOnly: true
            customerCode:
              title: Customer code
              description: >-
                The owner's customer code, formatted '<LAST3>-<NNNN>' where LAST3
                is the upper-cased first three letters of the last name and NNNN
                is a global 4-digit, zero-padded sequence assigned on create.
              type: string
              example: 'SMI-0007'
              readOnly: true
            householdId:
              title: Household ID
              description: >-
                A stable identifier shared by all owners of the same household
                (same last name and address). Assigned when an owner is created
                with 'sharesHousehold' set to true and an existing owner already
                lives at that address; the existing and joining owners then share
                this value. Absent for owners that do not share a household.
              type: string
              example: 'A1B2C3D4E5F6'
              readOnly: true
            identityKey:
              title: Identity key
              description: >-
                The single derived value all duplicate detection is based on,
                formed as '<normalizedTelephone>|<email>|<householdId>' where an
                absent email or household id contributes an empty segment.
                Creating an owner is rejected with 409 Conflict only when this
                whole key equals that of an existing owner.
              type: string
              example: '+61412345678||A1B2C3D4E5F6'
              readOnly: true
            namesakeCount:
              title: Namesake count
              description: >-
                The number of existing owners that, at the moment this owner was
                created, already shared the same first name and last name
                (compared case-insensitively). Assigned on create.
              type: integer
              format: int32
              minimum: 0
              example: 1
              readOnly: true
            membershipNumber:
              title: Membership number
              description: >-
                The owner's membership number, formatted '<customerCode>-M<YY>'
                where YY is the last two digits of the registration date year.
                Assigned on create.
              type: string
              example: 'SMI-0007-M26'
              readOnly: true
            membershipLevel:
              title: Membership level
              description: >-
                The owner's membership level, assigned on create: starting at 1,
                plus 1 when the owner has an email, plus 1 when the owner is
                uniquely named (a namesakeCount of 0), capped at 3. Level 4 is
                reserved for tenure.
              type: integer
              format: int32
              minimum: 1
              maximum: 4
              example: 3
              readOnly: true
            checkDigit:
              title: Check digit
              description: >-
                The single Luhn check digit computed over the digits of the
                owner's customer code.
              type: integer
              format: int32
              minimum: 0
              maximum: 9
              example: 4
              readOnly: true
            locality:
              title: Locality
              description: >-
                The canonical region derived from the owner's city via the fixed
                city-to-region table (Sydney->NSW, Melbourne->VIC,
                Brisbane->QLD), or 'UNKNOWN' when the city is not in the table.
              type: string
              example: 'NSW'
              readOnly: true
            bulkSignupWarning:
              title: Bulk signup warning
              description: >-
                True when more than 80 owners have already been registered today
                (by registration date), signalling an unusually high volume of
                sign-ups; false otherwise. Evaluated per response.
              type: boolean
              example: false
              readOnly: true
            contactPreference:
              title: Contact preference
              description: >-
                The owner's preferred contact channel: 'EMAIL' when an email is
                present, otherwise 'PHONE'. Evaluated per response.
              type: string
              enum:
                - EMAIL
                - PHONE
              example: 'EMAIL'
              readOnly: true
            pets:
              title: Pets
              description: The pets owned by this individual including any booked vet visits.
              type: array
              items:
                $ref: '#/components/schemas/Pet'
              readOnly: true
          required:
            - pets

components:

    ProblemDetail:
      title: Problem Detail
      description: The schema for all error responses.
      type: object
      properties:
        type:
          title: Type
          description: Full URL that originated the error response.
          type: string
          format: uri
          example: 'http://localhost:9966/petclinic/api/owner'

        title:
          title: Title
          description: The short error title.

          example: NoResourceFoundException
          readOnly: true
        status:
          title: Status
          description: HTTP status code
          type: integer
          format: int32
          minimum: 400
          maximum: 600
          exclusiveMaximum: true
          example: 500
          readOnly: true
        detail:
          title: Detail
          description: The long error message.
          type: string
          example: 'No static resource api/owner.'
          readOnly: true
        timestamp:
          title: Timestamp
          description: The time the error occurred.
          type: string
          format: date-time
          example: '2024-11-23T13:59:21.3820407Z'
          readOnly: true
        schemaValidationErrors:
          title: Schema validation errors
          description: Validation errors against the OpenAPI schema.
          type: array
          items:
            $ref: '#/components/schemas/ValidationMessage'
      required:
        - type
        - title
        - status
        - detail
        - timestamp
        - schemaValidationErrors
    ValidationMessage:
      title: Validation message
      description: Messages describing a validation error.
      type: object
      properties:
        message:
          title: Message

        lastName:

          type: string
          minLength: 1
          maxLength: 30

          title: City
          description: The city of the pet owner.

          maxLength: 80
          example: Madison
        telephone:
          title: Telephone number
          description: >-
            The telephone number of the pet owner. On create the value is
            normalized to E.164 form: a leading '+' and country code are kept,
            otherwise country code '+61' is assumed and a single leading '0' is
            dropped from the national digits; spaces, dashes and brackets are
            stripped. The result must be '+' followed by 8 to 15 digits, and this
            E.164 value is stored and returned.
          type: string
          minLength: 1
          maxLength: 20
          example: '+61412345678'
        email:
          title: Email address
          description: >-
            The optional email address of the pet owner. When present it must be
            a syntactically valid address; the value is stored and returned
            lower-cased.
          type: string
          maxLength: 255

        postcode:
          title: Postcode

            be valid for the owner's city: the city's region (Sydney->NSW,
            Melbourne->VIC, Brisbane->QLD) fixes an inclusive range (NSW
            2000-2099, VIC 3000-3099, QLD 4000-4099) that the postcode must fall
            within; a city with no known region accepts any 4-digit postcode. The
            value is stored and returned as given.

            already lives at the same last name and address, the new owner joins
            that household and shares its household id (compared
            case-insensitively, ignoring surrounding and repeated whitespace).
            Because the household id is part of the identity key, joining a
            household still leaves the new owner with a distinct identity as long
            as its telephone or email differs. This flag is not persisted.
          type: boolean
          example: false

            customerCode:
              title: Customer code
              description: >-
                The owner's customer code, formatted '<REGION>-<HASH8>' where
                REGION is the region code derived from the postcode and HASH8 is
                the first 8 upper-case hex characters of the SHA-256 digest of the
                normalized telephone concatenated with the last name. Assigned on
                create; it carries no sequence number.
              type: string
              example: 'NSW-1A2B3C4D'

            householdId:
              title: Household ID
              description: >-
                A stable identifier shared by all owners of the same household

            identityKey:

                absent email or household id contributes an empty segment.
                Creating an owner is rejected with 409 Conflict only when this
                whole key equals that of an existing owner.
              type: string
              example: '+61412345678||A1B2C3D4E5F6'
              readOnly: true
            namesakeCount:
              title: Namesake count

                created, already shared the same first name and last name

            membershipLevel:

              readOnly: true

components:
  schemas:
    ProblemDetail:
      title: Problem Detail
      description: The schema for all error responses.
      type: object
      properties:
        type:
          title: Type
          description: Full URL that originated the error response.
          type: string
          format: uri
          example: 'http://localhost:9966/petclinic/api/owner'
          readOnly: true
        title:
          title: Title
          description: The short error title.
          type: string
          example: NoResourceFoundException
          readOnly: true
        status:
          title: Status
          description: HTTP status code
          type: integer
          format: int32
          minimum: 400
          maximum: 600
          exclusiveMaximum: true
          example: 500
          readOnly: true
        detail:
          title: Detail
          description: The long error message.
          type: string
          example: 'No static resource api/owner.'
          readOnly: true
        timestamp:
          title: Timestamp
          description: The time the error occurred.
          type: string
          format: date-time
          example: '2024-11-23T13:59:21.3820407Z'
          readOnly: true
        schemaValidationErrors:
          title: Schema validation errors
          description: Validation errors against the OpenAPI schema.
          type: array
          items:
            $ref: '#/components/schemas/ValidationMessage'
      required:
        - type
        - title
        - status
        - detail
        - timestamp
        - schemaValidationErrors
    ValidationMessage:
      title: Validation message
      description: Messages describing a validation error.
      type: object
      properties:
        message:
          title: Message
          description: The validation message.
          type: string
          example: "[Path '/lastName'] Instance type (null) does not match any allowed primitive type (allowed: ['string'])"
          readOnly: true
      required:
        - message
      additionalProperties: true
    Specialty:
      title: Specialty
      description: Fields of specialty of vets.
      type: object
      properties:
        id:
          title: ID
          description: The ID of the specialty.
          type: integer
          format: int32
          minimum: 0
          example: 1
          readOnly: true
        name:
          title: Name
          description: The name of the specialty.
          type: string
          maxLength: 80
          minLength: 1
          example: radiology
      required:
        - id
        - name
    OwnerFields:
      title: Owner fields
      description: Editable fields of a pet owner.
      type: object
      properties:
        firstName:
          title: First name
          description: The first name of the pet owner.
          type: string
          minLength: 1
          maxLength: 30
          pattern: "^[\\p{L}]+([ '-][\\p{L}]+){0,2}$"
          example: George
        lastName:
          title: Last name
          description: The last name of the pet owner.
          type: string
          minLength: 1
          maxLength: 30
          pattern: "^[\\p{L}]+([ '-][\\p{L}]+){0,2}\\.?$"
          example: Franklin
        address:
          title: Address
          description: The postal address of the pet owner.
          type: string
          minLength: 1
          maxLength: 255
          example: '110 W. Liberty St.'
        city:
          title: City
          description: The city of the pet owner.
          type: string
          minLength: 1
          maxLength: 80
          example: Madison
        telephone:
          title: Telephone number
          description: >-
            The telephone number of the pet owner. On create the value is
            normalized to E.164 form: a leading '+' and country code are kept,
            otherwise country code '+61' is assumed and a single leading '0' is
            dropped from the national digits; spaces, dashes and brackets are
            stripped. The result must be '+' followed by 8 to 15 digits, and this
            E.164 value is stored and returned.
          type: string
          minLength: 1
          maxLength: 20
          example: '+61412345678'
        email:
          title: Email address
          description: >-
            The optional email address of the pet owner. When present it must be
            a syntactically valid address; the value is stored and returned
            lower-cased.
          type: string
          maxLength: 255
          example: george.franklin@example.com
        postcode:
          title: Postcode
          description: >-
            The optional 4-digit postcode of the pet owner. When present it must
            be valid for the owner's city: the city's region (Sydney->NSW,
            Melbourne->VIC, Brisbane->QLD) fixes an inclusive range (NSW
            2000-2099, VIC 3000-3099, QLD 4000-4099) that the postcode must fall
            within; a city with no known region accepts any 4-digit postcode. The
            value is stored and returned as given.
          type: string
          pattern: '^[0-9]{4}$'
          example: '2000'
        registrationDate:
          title: Registration date
          description: >-
            The date the pet owner was registered, formatted as 'YYYY-MM-DD'.
            When omitted on create it defaults to the server's current date.
          type: string
          format: date
          example: '2020-06-15'
        sharesHousehold:
          title: Shares household
          description: >-
            Optional create-time flag. When set to true and an existing owner
            already lives at the same last name and address, the new owner joins
            that household and shares its household id (compared
            case-insensitively, ignoring surrounding and repeated whitespace).
            Because the household id is part of the identity key, joining a
            household still leaves the new owner with a distinct identity as long
            as its telephone or email differs. This flag is not persisted.
          type: boolean
          example: false
      required:
        - firstName
        - lastName
        - address
        - city
        - telephone
    Owner:
      title: Owner
      description: A pet owner.
      allOf:
        - $ref: '#/components/schemas/OwnerFields'
        - type: object
          properties:
            id:
              title: ID
              description: The ID of the pet owner.
              type: integer
              format: int32
              minimum: 0
              example: 1
              readOnly: true
            displayName:
              title: Display name
              description: The pet owner's name formatted as 'LastName, FirstName'.
              type: string
              example: 'Franklin, George'
              readOnly: true
            initials:
              title: Initials
              description: >-
                The upper-cased first letters of the owner's first and last
                name, dot-separated with a trailing dot.
              type: string
              example: 'G.F.'
              readOnly: true
            customerCode:
              title: Customer code
              description: >-
                The owner's customer code, formatted '<REGION>-<HASH8>' where
                REGION is the region code derived from the postcode and HASH8 is
                the first 8 upper-case hex characters of the SHA-256 digest of the
                normalized telephone concatenated with the last name. Assigned on
                create; it carries no sequence number.
              type: string
              example: 'NSW-1A2B3C4D'
              readOnly: true
            householdId:
              title: Household ID
              description: >-
                A stable identifier shared by all owners of the same household
                (same last name and address). Assigned when an owner is created
                with 'sharesHousehold' set to true and an existing owner already
                lives at that address; the existing and joining owners then share
                this value. Absent for owners that do not share a household.
              type: string
              example: 'A1B2C3D4E5F6'
              readOnly: true
            identityKey:
              title: Identity key
              description: >-
                The single derived value all duplicate detection is based on,
                formed as '<normalizedTelephone>|<email>|<householdId>' where an
                absent email or household id contributes an empty segment.
                Creating an owner is rejected with 409 Conflict only when this
                whole key equals that of an existing owner.
              type: string
              example: '+61412345678||A1B2C3D4E5F6'
              readOnly: true
            namesakeCount:
              title: Namesake count
              description: >-
                The number of existing owners that, at the moment this owner was
                created, already shared the same first name and last name
                (compared case-insensitively). Assigned on create.
              type: integer
              format: int32
              minimum: 0
              example: 1
              readOnly: true
            membershipNumber:
              title: Membership number
              description: >-
                The owner's membership number, formatted '<customerCode>-M<YY>'
                where YY is the last two digits of the registration date year.
                Assigned on create.
              type: string
              example: 'NSW-1A2B3C4D-M26'
              readOnly: true
            membershipLevel:
              title: Membership level
              description: >-
                The owner's membership level, assigned on create: starting at 1,
                plus 1 when the owner has an email, plus 1 when the owner is
                uniquely named (a namesakeCount of 0), capped at 3. Level 4 is
                reserved for tenure.
              type: integer
              format: int32
              minimum: 1
              maximum: 4
              example: 3
              readOnly: true
            checkDigit:
              title: Check digit
              description: >-
                The single Luhn check digit computed over the digits of the
                owner's customer code.
              type: integer
              format: int32
              minimum: 0
              maximum: 9
              example: 4
              readOnly: true
            locality:
              title: Locality
              description: >-
                The canonical region derived from the owner's city via the fixed
                city-to-region table (Sydney->NSW, Melbourne->VIC,
                Brisbane->QLD), or 'UNKNOWN' when the city is not in the table.
              type: string
              example: 'NSW'
              readOnly: true
            bulkSignupWarning:
              title: Bulk signup warning
              description: >-
                True when more than 80 owners have already been registered today
                (by registration date), signalling an unusually high volume of
                sign-ups; false otherwise. Evaluated per response.
              type: boolean
              example: false
              readOnly: true
            contactPreference:
              title: Contact preference
              description: >-
                The owner's preferred contact channel: 'EMAIL' when an email is
                present, otherwise 'PHONE'. Evaluated per response.
              type: string
              enum:
                - EMAIL
                - PHONE
              example: 'EMAIL'
              readOnly: true
            pets:
              title: Pets
              description: The pets owned by this individual including any booked vet visits.
              type: array
              items:
                $ref: '#/components/schemas/Pet'
              readOnly: true
          required:
            - pets
